name: Acrylic Window Decor with Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES:

  • Premium Material:

Crafted from high-quality, transparent acrylic, this window hanging decoration is both durable and lightweight. It features elegant crystal charms (available in round or rainbow style) that catch and reflect sunlight beautifully, creating sparkling effects in any space.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in 5 size options to suit any display area:

 - 12x12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm

 - 10x10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm

 - 8x8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm

 - 6x6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm

 - 4x4 inches ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm

 

  • Crystal charm options:

Available in 2 hanging charm types to choose:

 - Round Charm: 3 cm (~ 1.18 in) diameter with 8 cm (~ 3.15 in) chain

 - Rainbow Charm: 3 cm (~ 1.18 in) bottom crystal, total length 16cm (~ 6.3 in)  including chain.

  • Acrylic Charm: 

Choose from a variety of sizes to match different display needs.

- 4x4 inches with a 2x2 inches acrylic hanging piece

 - 6x6 inches with a 3x3 inches acrylic hanging piece

 - 8x8 inches with a 4x4 inches acrylic hanging piece

 - 10x10 inches with a 4x4 inches acrylic hanging piece

 - 12x12 inches with a 4.8x4.8in acrylic hanging piece

 

  • Printing Technology:

Printed using advanced UV printing technology, ensuring vivid colors, crisp details, and long-lasting imagery. Each design is printed double-sided, allowing it to be beautifully visible from both inside and outside the window.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Perfect for hanging on windows, glass doors, mirrors, or anywhere light can pass through. The included suction cup and metal hanging chain make it easy to display in just seconds. The dazzling crystals scatter light and create a charming atmosphere in any room.

 

  • Perfect Gift for All Occasions:

An ideal gift for everyone, for any occasion — graduations, birthdays, holidays, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Christmas, or just because. This sentimental piece celebrates achievements and new beginnings, making it a heartfelt and lasting keepsake.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1xAcrylic Window Decor, 1x Crystal Charm or 1xAcrylic Charm

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
